name: awesome-anki
desc: A curated list of awesome Anki add-ons, decks and resources

resources.name: AnkiDecks AI
resources.desc: Shared Decks of the AnkiDecks AI community

resources.name: English Irregular verbs
resources.desc: A deck containing more than 170 english irregular verbs, the resource comes with audio, images and phrases as example.

resources.name: Effective learning: Twenty rules of formulating knowledge
resources.desc: The speed of learning will depend on the way you formulate the material. The same material can be learned many times faster if well formulated! The rules are listed in the order of importance.

resources.name: Mark Nagelberg
resources.desc: Data Science decks with personal notes from books, online courses and blog posts.

resources.name: Stefan van den Akker/supplementary-buttons-anki
resources.desc: Provides supplementary formatting buttons and Markdown for AnkiSRS, including Markdown, code blocks, lists, tables, syntax highlight and more.

resources.name: LaoHuang.net
resources.desc: A personal blog introducing author's self-developed anki tools. (_Simplified Chinese_)

resources.name: YouDaoDict To Anki
resources.desc: An online tool to help convert XML files exported by YouDao Dictionary to plain text files for Anki import. (See details in ecator/anki-youdao2anki project.)

resources.name: Anki Scripting for Non-Programmers
resources.desc: A guide to use the Anki internal API to automate the creation of your flashcards.

resources.name: Power up Anki with Emacs, Org mode, anki-editor and more
resources.desc: A detailed blog introducing how to quickly add/edit Anki cards with the powerful Emacs editor.

resources.name: Limbiks
resources.desc: A website that automatically generates flashcards from powerpoints, pdfs, notes, documents, images and more!

resources.name: AnkiDecks AI
resources.desc: AnkiDecks AI generates flashcards and image occlusions from any file using AI!

resources.name: MedAnkiGen
resources.desc: MedAnkiGen creates high-quality medical flashcards from PDF, presentations, and lecture transcripts, helping medical students optimize their study process.
